description: This file implements a key-value pair vector data structure with functions for initialization, addition, removal, replacement, retrieval, validation, and destruction. It includes handling for various data types and serialization/deserialization utilities, and is part of a larger project related to data modeling and configuration management.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_Init
methods.description: Initializes a key-value vector structure by setting its vector pointer to NULL and entry count to zero.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the vector, duplicating the key and value strings.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_Remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair identified by key, freeing associated memory and shifting remaining entries.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_Replace
methods.description: Replaces all values for a given key with a new value, returning true if replaced.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_ReplaceWithHint
methods.description: Replaces the value for a key at a hinted index, improving efficiency if the position is known.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_AddUnsigned
methods.description: Adds a key with an unsigned integer value converted to string.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_AddBool
methods.description: Adds a key with a boolean value converted to string.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_AddDateTime
methods.description: Adds a key with a date-time value formatted as ISO8601 string.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_AddEnum
methods.description: Adds a key with an enum value converted to string.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_AddHexNumber
methods.description: Adds a key with binary data converted to a hex string.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with the vector and resets its state.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_Dump
methods.description: Logs all key-value pairs in the vector.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_FindKey
methods.description: Finds the index of a key in the vector, searching from a start index.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, or default if not found.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_GetUnsigned
methods.description: Retrieves a key's value as an unsigned integer, with error handling.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_GetUnsignedWithinRange
methods.description: Retrieves a key's value as an unsigned integer within specified bounds.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_GetInt
methods.description: Retrieves a key's value as an integer, with error handling.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_GetIntWithinRange
methods.description: Retrieves a key's value as an integer within specified bounds.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_GetBool
methods.description: Retrieves a key's value as a boolean.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_GetDateTime
methods.description: Retrieves a key's value as a date-time.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_GetHexNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a key's value as binary data.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_GetEnum
methods.description: Retrieves a key's value as an enum.

methods.name: KV_VECTOR_ValidateArguments
methods.description: Validates argument keys against a schema, checking for duplicates and schema conformity.
